title: The bird on the tarp
logline: The lawn chair under its tarp between Christmas and the year's end, and the bird on the tarp's peak, every color on the blue plastic. The page's only color that isn't the bird's is the tarp's.

panels.composition: An old lawn chair under a blue tarp on a dock in gray December light with the small rainbow bird perched on the tarp's peak.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old lawn chair under a blue tarp on a wooden dock in gray December light with a small rainbow bird perched on the tarp's peak, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
